panels.title: Fleet coverage - all business units at a glance
panels.description: One row per business unit. Different BUs emit different signals; all governed from one pane.

azureLogAnalytics.query: union isfuzzy=true (workspace('/subscriptions/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu1').AppGenAIContent | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | extend BU='Business unit 1', S='Interactions', v=1.0), (workspace('/subscriptions/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu1').AppGenAIContent | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | extend BU='Business unit 1', S='Tokens', v=todouble(toint(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])+toint(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']))), (workspace('/subscriptions/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu1').ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | extend BU='Business unit 1', S='GatewayCalls', v=1.0), (workspace('/subscriptions/33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333/resourceGroups/rg-dev/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu2').ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | extend BU='Business unit 2', S='GatewayCalls', v=1.0), (workspace('/subscriptions/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu1').AppExceptions | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | extend BU='Business unit 1', S='Exceptions', v=1.0), (workspace('/subscriptions/33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333/resourceGroups/rg-dev/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu2').AppExceptions | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | extend BU='Business unit 2', S='Exceptions', v=1.0), (workspace('/subscriptions/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu1').AppEvents | where Name == 'gen_ai.evaluation.result' | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | extend BU='Business unit 1', S='Evals', v=1.0) | summarize Interactions=sumif(v, S=='Interactions'), Tokens=sumif(v, S=='Tokens'), GatewayCalls=sumif(v, S=='GatewayCalls'), Enforcement=sumif(v, S=='Enforcement'), Exceptions=sumif(v, S=='Exceptions'), Evals=sumif(v, S=='Evals') by BU | order by BU asc

union isfuzzy=true (workspace('/subscriptions/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu1').AppGenAIContent | extend BU='Business unit 1') | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | summarize Interactions=count()

workspace('/subscriptions/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu1').AzureMetrics | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.COGNITIVESERVICES' | summarize Calls=sumif(Total, MetricName=='TotalCalls')

union isfuzzy=true (workspace('/subscriptions/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu1').AppGenAIContent | extend BU='Business unit 1') | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | summarize Interactions=count() by BU, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) | order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: AOAI native platform metrics (Business unit 1, no instrumentation)

azureLogAnalytics.query: workspace('/subscriptions/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu1').AzureMetrics | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.COGNITIVESERVICES' | summarize TotalTokens=sumif(Total, MetricName=='TotalTokens'), TotalCalls=sumif(Total, MetricName=='TotalCalls'), AvgLatencyMs=round(avgif(Average, MetricName=='Latency'),0) by Resource | order by TotalTokens desc

workspace('/subscriptions/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu1').AppEvents | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | where Name == 'gen_ai.evaluation.result' | extend p=parse_json(tostring(Properties)) | extend Evaluator=tostring(p['gen_ai.evaluation.name']), Score=toreal(p['gen_ai.evaluation.score.value']), Label=tostring(p['gen_ai.evaluation.score.label']) | summarize Runs=count(), AvgScore=round(avg(Score),2), Passed=countif(Label=='pass') by Evaluator | order by Evaluator asc

union isfuzzy=true (workspace('/subscriptions/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu1').AppExceptions | extend BU='Business unit 1'), (workspace('/subscriptions/33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333/resourceGroups/rg-dev/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu2').AppExceptions | extend BU='Business unit 2') | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | summarize Exceptions=count() by BU, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) | order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Gateway response codes by business unit

azureLogAnalytics.query: union isfuzzy=true (workspace('/subscriptions/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu1').ApiManagementGatewayLogs | extend BU='Business unit 1'), (workspace('/subscriptions/33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333/resourceGroups/rg-dev/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu2').ApiManagementGatewayLogs | extend BU='Business unit 2') | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | summarize Calls=count() by BU, ResponseCode=tostring(ResponseCode) | order by BU asc, Calls desc

panels.title: Model-seal posture by business unit (OPEN BACK DOOR = public network on)

azureResourceGraph.query: resources | where type == 'microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts' | extend BU=case(subscriptionId=='22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222','Business unit 1',subscriptionId=='33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333','Business unit 2','Other') | summarize accounts=count(), openBackDoor=countif(tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess)=='Enabled'), sealed=countif(tostring(properties.publicNetworkAccess)=='Disabled') by BU | extend Posture=iff(openBackDoor>0,'OPEN BACK DOOR','Sealed') | order by BU asc

panels.title: Models in use by business unit

azureLogAnalytics.query: union isfuzzy=true (workspace('/subscriptions/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu1').AppGenAIContent | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | extend BU='Business unit 1', Model=tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.response.model'])) | where isnotempty(Model) | summarize Calls=count() by BU, Model | order by Calls desc

workspace('/subscriptions/22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222/resourceGroups/rg-prod/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/law-bu1').AppGenAIContent | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | where isnotempty(ToolCallResult) or isnotempty(ToolCallArguments) | summarize toolCalls=count(), withResult=countif(isnotempty(ToolCallResult)) by AgentName=tostring(AgentName) | extend resultCoveragePct=round(100.0*withResult/toolCalls,0) | order by toolCalls desc
